title: 第十四章 暗网围死
slug: 穿越戍边我从炮灰辅卒一路封王
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

斥候这番话，像一块千斤寒冰，狠狠砸在所有人心头。

山洞内外，瞬间死寂。

呼啸的风雪还在不停灌进来，打在墙壁上哗哗作响，可没有一个人有心思去躲闪。

所有人脸上的血色，这一刻彻底褪得干干净净。

之前众人心里还存着一丝侥幸。

只当是雁朔关派了两个探子偷偷摸过来摸底，顶多就是一两个叛卒混在羯骑里通风报信。

可谁能想到，对方手笔这么大。

压根不是零星几个人作祟，而是一整队正规兵，悄悄潜伏在了戍堡外围！

他们躲在暗处不露头、不进攻、不闹出半点动静。

就这么安安静静待着，死死盯着黑石戍堡的每一处动静。

周疤子喉结狠狠滚动一下，压着嗓子，声音又沉又抖：“你看仔细了？是成建制的驻军痕迹？”

“看仔细了！绝对没错！”

斥候浑身落满白雪，冻得手脚僵硬，却拼命点头，语气无比笃定。

“零散探子只会留零散脚印，可外围雪地里，是规律的散点蹲守痕迹！”

“有人专门盯堡门，有人盯后山洞口，有人堵两侧退路，分工清清楚楚！”

“就是正规边关守军的布哨手法，错不了！”

刘屯将死死攥着手里的长枪，枪杆都被他捏得微微变形，眼底满是彻骨的寒意。

“好家伙……真是好手段。”

“不攻城，不厮杀，就这么悄无声息把我们围在中间。”

“我们抬头看不见敌人，低头走不出视线，一举一动，全都在人家眼皮子底下。”

这话一出，周围不少士卒都攥紧了兵器，胸膛剧烈起伏。

太阴毒了。

羯族大军摆明了是正面的死敌。

可雁朔关这支潜伏队伍，是藏在黑暗里的刀子。

他们不打、不闹、不现身。

只需要把戍堡的兵力变动、伤员情况、物资多少、防守布局，一字不落全部传出去。

等三天后羯王主力一到，人家拿着精准情报，对着他们所有软肋猛攻。

这根本不是打仗，这是被人锁死手脚，等着被活活屠宰。

“从上到下，全是烂的……”

一名老兵嘴唇发白，低声喃喃自语，眼里的精气神几乎彻底垮掉。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The scout's words were like a piece of ice weighing heavily, hitting everyone's hearts.

Inside and outside the cave, there was a moment of deathly silence.

The howling wind and snow continued to pour in, hitting the walls with a rattling sound, but no one had the intention to dodge.

The color on everyone's faces completely faded away at this moment.

Before, everyone still had a trace of luck in their hearts.

It can only be assumed that Yanshuoguan sent two spies to sneak over to find out. At most, there were one or two traitors mixed in with Jieqi to report the news.

But who would have thought that the other party would be so generous.

It's not just a few people who are causing trouble, but a whole team of regular soldiers quietly lurking outside the fortress!

They hide in the dark without showing their heads, don't attack, and don't make any noise.

He just waited quietly, staring at every movement in the Black Stone Fortress.

Zhou Scarzi's Adam's apple rolled hard, and he suppressed his throat. His voice was deep and trembling: "Did you look carefully? Are they signs of an organized garrison?"

"Look carefully! It's absolutely right!"

The scout's body was covered with white snow, and his hands and feet were stiff from the cold, but he nodded desperately and his tone was extremely determined.

"Scattered spies will only leave scattered footprints, but in the snow outside, there are regular scattered squatting marks!"

"Some people are specifically watching the fort gate, some are watching the entrance to the back mountain cave, and some are blocking the retreat on both sides. There is a clear division of labor!"

"It's just the regular sentry method used by border guards, it's unmistakable!"

General Liu Tun clutched the spear in his hand tightly, the barrel of the gun was slightly deformed by his pinching, and his eyes were filled with a bone-chilling chill.

"Good guy...what a good trick."

"No attacking the city, no fighting, just quietly surrounding us."

"We can't see the enemy when we look up, and we can't get out of sight when we look down. Every move we make is under their noses."

As soon as these words came out, many soldiers around him clenched their weapons and their chests heaved violently.

Too sinister.

The Jie Clan army is clearly a deadly enemy from the front.

But the lurking team in Yanshuoguan is a knife hidden in the darkness.

They don’t fight, don’t make trouble, and don’t show up.

All you need to do is to transmit the changes in the garrison's troop strength, the status of the wounded, the amount of supplies, and the defensive layout, word for word.

When the main force of King Jie arrives three days later, they will use accurate intelligence to attack all their weaknesses.

This is not fighting at all, this is being chained hand and foot, waiting to be slaughtered alive.

"It's all rotten from top to bottom..."

A veteran's lips turned white and he murmured in a low voice. The energy in his eyes was almost completely broken.
